```{r}
over_5k_tagged      <- read_csv("../08_alternative_pipeline/08_outputs/over_5k_tagged.csv")
pac_classifiability <- read_csv("../08_alternative_pipeline/08_outputs/pac_classifiability.csv")
ordered_pacs        <- read_csv("../08_alternative_pipeline/08_outputs/pac_traversal_order.csv") %>% arrange(order) %>% pull(pac_id)
stuck_pacs          <- read_csv("../08_alternative_pipeline/08_outputs/pac_stuck_pacs.csv") %>% pull(pac_id)
classified_out      <- read_csv("../08_alternative_pipeline/08_outputs/classified_contributors.csv")

over_5k_by_pac      <- split(over_5k_tagged, over_5k_tagged$parent_pac_id)
classifiability_idx <- setNames(seq_len(nrow(pac_classifiability)), pac_classifiability$pac_id)
pac_deps            <- over_5k_tagged %>%
  filter(contributor_type %in% c("pac", "major_donor_ie_committee"), !is.na(contributor_id)) %>%
  distinct(parent_pac_id, contributor_id) %>%
  group_by(parent_pac_id) %>%
  summarise(deps = list(contributor_id), .groups = "drop") %>%
  { setNames(.$deps, .$parent_pac_id) }

```


```{r}
classified_out <- read_csv("../08_alternative_pipeline/08_outputs/classified_contributors.csv")

# rebuild the unit ids to join on
over_5k_classified <- direct_for_classification %>%
  mutate(
    entity_id = if_else(
      !is.na(std_contributor_id),
      paste0("id_", std_contributor_id),
      sapply(contributor_name, function(n) hash_id(n, "indiv"))
    ),
    unit_key               = paste(entity_id,
                                   coalesce(processed_employer_name, ""),
                                   coalesce(processed_occupation, ""),
                                   sep = "||"),
    classification_unit_id = sapply(unit_key, function(k) hash_id(k, "unit"))
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    classified_out %>% select(classification_unit_id, level1_category, level2_category),
    by = "classification_unit_id"
  )

# flag entities with industry conflicts across aliases, collapse to one row per entity per PAC
entity_classifications <- over_5k_classified %>%
  group_by(parent_pac_id, entity_group) %>%
  mutate(
    n_distinct_industries = n_distinct(level1_category, na.rm = TRUE),
    final_industry = case_when(
      n_distinct_industries > 1 ~ "CONFLICT_REVIEW",
      !is.na(level1_category)   ~ level1_category,
      TRUE                      ~ "UNCLASSIFIED"
    )
  ) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup()


direct_by_pac_list <- split(
  entity_classifications %>%
    group_by(pac_id = parent_pac_id, industry = final_industry) %>%
    summarise(amount = sum(contributor_amount, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop"),
  ~ .$pac_id
)

industry_distrib <- list()

compute_industry_distrib <- function(pid) {
  direct <- direct_by_pac_list[[pid]]
  ind_amounts <- if (!is.null(direct) && nrow(direct) > 0)
    setNames(direct$amount, direct$industry) else numeric(0)

  pac_rows <- over_5k_by_pac[[pid]] %>%
    filter(contributor_type %in% c("pac", "major_donor_ie_committee"),
           !is.na(contributor_id))

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(pac_rows))) {
    child_id     <- pac_rows$contributor_id[i]
    child_amount <- pac_rows$contributor_amount[i]
    child_dist   <- industry_distrib[[child_id]]
    if (is.null(child_dist) || length(child_dist) == 0) {
      ind_amounts["UNCLASSIFIED"] <- coalesce(ind_amounts["UNCLASSIFIED"], 0) + child_amount
      next
    }
    child_total <- sum(child_dist)
    if (child_total <= 0) next
    scaled <- child_dist / child_total * child_amount
    for (ind in names(scaled))
      ind_amounts[ind] <- coalesce(ind_amounts[ind], 0) + scaled[ind]
  }
  industry_distrib[[pid]] <<- ind_amounts
}

for (pid in ordered_pacs) compute_industry_distrib(pid)

remaining_ind <- stuck_pacs
while (length(remaining_ind) > 0) {
  ready <- Filter(function(pid) {
    deps <- pac_deps[[pid]]; is.null(deps) || !any(deps %in% remaining_ind)
  }, remaining_ind)
  if (length(ready) == 0) ready <- remaining_ind
  for (pid in ready) compute_industry_distrib(pid)
  remaining_ind <- setdiff(remaining_ind, ready)
}

pac_industry_breakdown <- lapply(names(industry_distrib), function(pid) {
  ind <- industry_distrib[[pid]]
  if (length(ind) == 0) return(NULL)
  tibble(pac_id = pid, industry = names(ind), amount = unname(ind))
}) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  left_join(pac_classifiability %>% select(pac_id, total_received), by = "pac_id") %>%
  mutate(pct_of_total = amount / total_received) %>%
  arrange(pac_id, desc(amount))

```
